_comment: Scopes .claude/hooks/*.js files as CommonJS, regardless of parent package.json. Required when the bootstrapped project declares "type": "module" at its root (e.g. SvelteKit, modern Next.js) — without this file, Node tries to load visual-verify-nudge.js as ESM and crashes on require(). The hook then silently exit-0s (per its own failure-mode design) and the PostToolUse reminder never reaches Claude. This file propagates to new projects via bootstrap.sh.
